## Summary

Explain what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] I checked the result at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths for visual changes.
- [ ] I attached screenshots or a short recording for visual or motion changes.
- [ ] I checked reduced-motion behaviour for new or changed animations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one concern.
- [ ] TypeScript remains strict and introduces no unnecessary `any`.
- [ ] Effects clean up their listeners, observers, timers, and animation frames.
- [ ] I did not add an unnecessary runtime dependency.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
